scope: Adult domain gaps and policy bypass/resilience audit across native Mac enforcement, Chrome, Safari shared guard, and the free supervised Vigil Social phone policy.

fixedFindings.problem: Missing/stale/display hostname fields could disagree with the actual HTTP(S) destination.
fixedFindings.fix: Actual parsed URL host drives immediate, routine and durable recovered policy decisions; exact-tab redirect preconditions retained.

fixedFindings.problem: Selecting another blocklist cleared active committed data before the replacement fetch validated.
fixedFindings.fix: Retain committed source/hash/path and phone artifact through pending selection, fetch failure and artifact validation. Commit replacement only after validation.

fixedFindings.problem: Missing/corrupt committed snapshots silently reduced bulk protection.
fixedFindings.fix: Native/extension HTTP browsing enters recovery blocking until verified repair; preserve existing phone artifact. Only exact local plain-HTTP Vigil origin is exempt.

fixedFindings.problem: Long-tail adult frame domains outside finite DNR preload lacked authoritative document checks.
fixedFindings.fix: Authenticated per-frame current-document checks; conceal document and pause media pending authorization; retry transient stale registration under a3s deadline; failures close only the frame. Stale/late replies never authorize replacement or terminally closed frames.

fixedFindings.problem: Middle-click/context-menu actions could discard explicit source-card evidence before opaque destination inspection.
fixedFindings.fix: Apply the same explicit label/context gate to auxiliary click and context menu.

fixedFindings.problem: Legacy native service gates could accept dot segments, nested encoded route names/separators and credentials.
fixedFindings.fix: Reject structurally ambiguous native paths before navigation, preserving legitimate Unicode names and opaque authentication queries.

fixedFindings.problem: Mac parental-control export applied the iOS500-entry cap and silently dropped later denies.
fixedFindings.fix: Remove truncation from the Mac filterDenyList; preserve single required Mac payload and all generated denies. iOS BuiltIn DenyListURLs still obey500per payload.

fixedFindings.problem: Paired DNR ranges supported1000but caller overrides were clipped to250.
fixedFindings.fix: Allow explicit browser override up to1000; retain250saved network/phone preload cap and priority-before-bulk ordering.

semanticUrlScanning.scope: HTTP(S) hostname labels and first four meaningful path segments; percent encoding, IDN/punycode, NFKC and selected homoglyph normalization.
semanticUrlScanning.checks: Strong explicit words, deliberate X labels, media/catalog contextual weak words and compounds.
semanticUrlScanning.excludedFromNewHelper: Queries, fragments, credentials, ports and deep opaque identifiers. Existing explicit search/custom rules retain their previous scope.

validation.independentReview: Three agents implemented disjoint work; fresh cross-review found and fixed pending-frame exposure, late-reply reopening, replacement-root restoration and nested Swift route names.
validation.renderedBrowserAttempt: An isolated Electron rendering probe was prevented by existing unsupported-browser enforcement (Electron is denied); it did not complete and is not counted as passing. No enforcement workaround used.

remainingBoundaries: Phone deployment remains deferred until USB; source validation is not a live-device receipt.
Chrome source/archive is prepared; store publication or installed-client verification must be recorded separately.

Non-HTTP file/data/blob/srcdoc/inherited blank documents and failed native URL telemetry are outside this audited HTTP destination coverage; no universal custom system-wide iOS URL filter is claimed under Personal Team signing.
Local administrative access to both state and HMAC keys remains outside the existing integrity-seal threat model.
